name: Cherry Shrimp (Neocaridina davidi)
description: Hardy beginner shrimp; selectively bred into many color morphs (cherry, fire, sakura, yellow, blue). Tolerates a wide parameter range but breeding stalls below ~22 °C. Vulnerable to most fish — pair only with truly peaceful, small-mouthed tankmates. Schooling minimum reflects 'visible colony' rather than survival.
